back.head: Modules
lines: PROSPX, 2026-05-17. The prospect board: {{prospx.tracked}} players tracked, {{prospx.active}} active, each graded on a consensus of seven ranking sources. Player cards, farm grades, draft and international boards. Spotlights co-created with Anirudh Iyer.
MLB Projections, 2026-06-10. A Marcel-style engine with LightGBM quantile heads. Gate 1: {{proj.gate1}}.
Free Agency, 2026-06-10. Years, guarantee and AAV on a deferral-adjusted NPV basis. Gate 2: {{fa.gate2}}.
CollegeSavant, 2026-06-11, co-created with Joseph Gillis. I carried his framework onto the site's theme and added the college to Single-A K% and BB% translation.
MLB Stats, 2026-06-30. Leaderboards for the plus stats below, with Leverage Index and win probability from play-by-play.
Alchemy Lab, 2026-06-30. Starter and reliever conversion fit scores and a pitch-add recommender. Registry: {{verdict.pal_conversion}}.
Trade Machine, 2026-07-05. Dollar surplus per player and a trade evaluator, built on Anirudh Iyer's trade value engine.
Fantasy, 2026-07-19. Dynasty, redraft and DFS boards, with a combined dynasty rank in each of four Ottoneu formats.
Sports Betting and the Diamond, 2026-08-05. Model prices against the market and a shadow ledger of every posted selection.
Arbitration, 2026-08-09. Arb-1 salaries at {{arb.arb1}}. The MLB Trade Rumors projection is closer: {{arb.swartz}}. Recorded as a null.
Hall of Fame, 2026-09-06. Repaired the induction ledger, which was missing 130 of 354 inductees. Baseball-Reference's HoF Monitor beats every in-house column. Recorded as a loss.
In-Game Management, 2026-09-06. A descriptive ledger of nine decision families. No manager plus metric: club decision value failed its split-half gate.
Club Ledger, 2026-09-23. {{ledger.clubs}} club files, each row layer tested against the club roll-up.
Franchises, 2026-09-23. The Franchise Index puts eWAR, projected wins and farm grade on a descriptive 100 + 10z scale across the 30 clubs.
Also the Library (2026-06-10), Prospect News (2026-06-20), Park Factors and History (2026-07-29) and Model Accountability (2026-08-07).

back.head: Models and metrics
lines: eFV, first shipped as xFV on 2026-06-22. Prospect Future Value fit to realized WAR from translated minor-league production, age for level and scout grades. {{efv.claim}}
xFV's rank win over consensus was retired on 2026-09-04, when the gap fell inside what the eval can resolve.

eWAR v2, 2026-08-04, with Will Cahoon. The Baseball-Reference run frame with pitching moved onto FIP: {{ewar.n}} player-seasons, {{ewar.span}}. The label epoch of 2026-09-04 measured no accuracy gain. Recorded as a null.
fWAR replica, 2026-09-11. FanGraphs WAR rebuilt component by component from its public inputs. Registry: {{verdict.fwar_replica}}.
The plus stats are empirical-Bayes shrunk indexes, each tested on the next season.
DEM+, 2026-09-11, pre-registered: {{plus.dem}}.
KRP+ and RPS+ ship as display indexes, registered {{verdict.krp_plus}}. Swing+ is Will Cahoon's model; I wrote the ingest that scores tracked MLB swings with it.
Betting model, 2026-08-05. A run-scoring regression with a Skellam margin: {{bet.vintage}}. Registry: {{verdict.betting_game_prob}}.
Win expectancy, 2026-09-06. A team-blind state model on play-by-play. Registry: {{verdict.win_expectancy_state}}.
Surplus value. Expected-value surplus with an isotonic map fit on resolved cohorts. Registry: {{verdict.prospect_surplus}}.
Postseason bracket simulator, 2026-10-01. Exact series recursion over the posted bracket. Registry: {{verdict.postseason_bracket_sim}} until its read after the World Series.
Postseason results ingest for F-SCORE, 2026-10-02. Every bracket from 2000, each checked against its identities.

back.head: Data systems
lines: Ingest for every FV source on the board: FanGraphs, MLB Pipeline, Baseball America, ESPN, The Athletic, Just Baseball and TJStats.
Game, Statcast, WAR and contract data from the MLB Stats API, Baseball Savant, Baseball-Reference and Spotrac.
A SQLite snapshot store of every ranking as published. Point-in-time vintages: a backtest reads only what was public on its date.
Identity resolution across MLBAM, FanGraphs and Baseball-Reference ids, with a repair ledger and collision tests.
Nightly and monthly pipelines that rebuild every artifact and page.

back.head: Evaluation
lines: Model registry: {{registry.n}} rows on {{registry.date}}. {{registry.validated}} validated, {{registry.provisional}} provisional, {{registry.unvalidated}} unvalidated, {{registry.deprecated}} deprecated. Each row names its eval artifact and a freshness clock. Losses stay on the record.
{{gates.n}} gate documents, each written before its number is read.
Reserved frames: the 2020 and 2021 list vintages and the 2025 and later debut cohorts stay unscored until their registered read.
Claims tests: an accuracy claim on the site must come from an artifact, or the suite fails.
Source Comparison ledger in the Library: eFV against consensus and each outlet on the vintage-matched frame, {{efv.ledger_rows}} rows logged.
{{tests.files}} test files, {{tests.functions}} test functions.

members.name: Will Cahoon
back: eWAR: instrumental in its creation. Designed the pitcher eWAR (pitcher-ewar-1.1.0), a run-value decomposition into fielding-independent runs, contact suppression, home-run opportunity and conversion, park and league adjustment and replacement level, over 4,371 MLB pitcher-seasons from 2021 to 2025.

eWAR: his milb-projections package (2026-07-18) holds the pitcher eWAR's MLB and MiLB export contracts and adapters, and his watermarked defense-plus code is the fielding leg (career defensive runs and WAR, catcher components). The merged eWAR the site has declared is his pitcher leg plus SDR fielding.

SDR: created it. A defensive run metric with range, arm, framing, blocking and double-play pivot components. Its method is his defense-plus pipeline, from reliability and latent range talent through position migration, MiLB translation and catcher components. eWAR's fielding leg waits on its data.

Swing+: created it. Bat speed, swing length, attack angle, path tilt and intercept point, scored on tracked MLB swings, 100 = league average. The site runs his model on player cards, the GFX rail and MLB Projections. The same tree holds Decision+, B2B+ and Hitter+.
Prospect defensive value: his thesis that a prospect's defensive home is a probability over positions, moved by body frame and age. The site's reconstruction carries his mark: {{defval.fg}}.
MiLB Decision+: pitch extraction, zone calibration and level translation for minor-league swing decisions.
